**Abstraction package:** `internal/idp` - This package defines the provider abstraction with the `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct (see `internal/idp/idp.go`).

**Implementation package:** `internal/idp/oauth2` - This package provides the concrete OAuth2 protocol implementation with the `IdentityProvider` type (see `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`) that is instantiated and used in the authentication flow (as seen in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go`).

**Answer:** `internal/idp`; `internal/idp/oauth2`
